# External-extension evidence

RFC-EXT-0001 §10.2/§11.3 requires SHA-bound proof that an **unchanged** CLI
binary can use extensions from physically separate Git repositories. This
directory holds that evidence.

* `schema.json` — JSON Schema for the evidence manifest.
* `<40-hex-source-SHA>/manifest.json` — generated by
  `tools/ci/verify_extension_contracts.py`; never hand-written.

Generation (from a clean fixture checkout and a release build of this repo):

```bash
cargo build --release --locked -p marqdo-cli
CLI="$(realpath target/release/marqdo)"
python3 tools/ci/verify_extension_contracts.py \
  --cli "$CLI" \
  --fixtures /path/to/marqdo-extension-conformance
python3 tools/ci/verify_extension_contracts.py \
  --validate docs/evidence/extension/<SHA>/manifest.json
```

The generator refuses to write evidence when:

* the CLI binary hash changes between the start and end of the suite;
* the fixture repository has uncommitted changes;
* a required result is missing or `FAIL`;
* `UNSUPPORTED`/`SKIPPED` is recorded without `--allow-unverified` and a report
  entry explaining the platform limitation.

A local or container run is **not** a substitute for the release gates in
`docs/releasing.md` (G3/G4), and no tag is created by this evidence.
